title: Process identity probe
responsibility: Reads a process start time with ps so callers can distinguish a live process from a later process that reused its PID; unreadable probes remain unknown.

inputs.name: ProcessIdentityAdapter.find.pid
inputs.description: The process number, converted with String() and passed to ps as the -p argument; together with the exists and startedAt facts read for it, this number lets callers tell a process from a later one that was given the same number. The adapter does no integer or range check, so any value given here is sent to ps in its string form.

outputs.name: ProcessIdentityAdapter.find
outputs.description: The ProcessFacts object find returns: exists is true only when ps exits with code 0 and prints a non-empty start time, false when ps exits with code 1 (the code it uses for a number no process has) or exits with code 0 and nothing is left after trimming, and undefined when the probe cannot establish identity (any other exit code, or a thrown error whose status is not 1), in which case nothing is claimed either way. startedAt is the trimmed text ps prints for lstart under LC_ALL=C, or null whenever no start time was read, and it is not parsed into a date.
